subject: Per-route debugging instrumentation priorities and exception schedule
messages:
From: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@acme.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: alex.berman@acme.com
Date: 2026-11-12T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Request: per-route debugging + high-cost flow breakdown

Hi Tessa,

Quick note from our engineering team after the spike last week — we saw a handful of chat flows where cost per session jumped ~3x and latency increased unpredictably. We need a way to: 1) map high-cost sessions to route-level sequences (prompt templates + tools), and 2) get a reproducible debug payload that includes token paths, KV cache hits, and per-kernel timing.

Can Redwood provide a short-term telemetry spike plan (what to add to the console today) and a prioritized list of instrumentation we should expect in the next 2 sprints? Our SREs want something they can latch onto to triage and correlate with application logs.

Attaching a small perf snapshot we exported.

Thanks —
Jamie Ortiz
Director, Site Reliability — Acme Corp
[attachment: perf-snapshot.csv (CSV, 42KB)]

From: tessa.morgan@redwood.com <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@acme.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, jasmine.liu@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-12T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: per-route debugging + high-cost flow breakdown

Hi Jamie — thanks for the snapshot and the clear asks.

High level: we can (A) add a short-term console tile that surfaces per-route token-path histograms and KV-cache hit rates, and (B) deliver a prioritized instrumentation checklist for in-depth debugging (per-kernel timings, prefix-cache diagnostics, and prompt-template telemetry).

Actions I propose this week:
- Marcus: propose a 48-hour spike to create the console tile and wire it to tenant X-ray (INF-3271).
- Jasmine: define the instrumentation priority workbook and list of events we need in the event stream.
- Ben: coordinate with Ops to enable a short-lived higher-sampling trace on the Acme tenant for the next 72 hours.

Jamie — can you confirm the time window you'd like us to enable the sampling? Also sharing an initial M-A-P for approvals.

I'll follow up with a short plan and a timeline by EOD.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Product Manager, Console & Observability
Redwood Inference
[attachment: mutual-action-plan.docx (DOCX, 28KB)]

From: marcus.lin@redwood.com <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, jasmine.liu@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T14:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: per-route debugging + high-cost flow breakdown

Thanks Tessa — reading the perf snapshot now. Quick notes:

1) Short-term plan (48 hrs) — console tile + higher sampling
   - Tile shows: top 10 routes by cost delta, median/95/99 latency by route, KV-cache hit ratio per route slice, and a link to the raw token-path trace.
   - Implementation: a fast renderer that reuses existing route-aggregation store; should be ~2 days dev + 1 day UX polish.

2) Instrumentation priority (instrumentation-priority.xlsx attached)
   - P1 (ship in 2 sprints): per-token kernel timing, explicit KV-cache hit/miss event, route-level prompt-template id tagging.
   - P2 (next quarter): prefix caching metrics, tokenizer-level emit points, and function-calling timing breakdowns.

3) Ops coordination: Ben, we need a temporary 10x sampling window for Acme tenant starting when they say go. We'll capture full token-path traces to S3 with TTL 7 days.

Risks: capturing full token-path traces increases cost and privacy surface; will add a retention and redaction policy in the plan.

Attaching the instrumentation workbook. Will update INF-3271 with the spike ticket and ETA.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Software Engineer, Observability
Redwood Inference
[attachment: instrumentation-priority.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)]

From: jasmine.liu@redwood.com <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T12:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: per-route debugging + high-cost flow breakdown

All — quick clarifications from a UX/ops handoff perspective before we kick the spike:

- Sampling window: Jamie, if you can confirm a 48–72 hour window starting Monday 2026-11-16 we can align Dev/Ops availability.
- Console tile behavior: default to aggregated view (cost + latency) with a toggle to expand into individual token-path traces (downloadable).
- Privacy guardrails: we will redact PII from traces by default and only export the private traces to a secured S3 path with a short TTL.
- Rollout plan: 1) spike branch + demo to Acme SREs, 2) 72-hour sampling, 3) follow-up retro with action items and permanent instrumentation PRs.

Ben — can you confirm you have capacity to flip sampling and to apply the S3 retention policy? I can take the demo notes and the UX screenshots for the Acme team.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Design Lead, Observability
Redwood Inference
